_comment: Whole-repo duplication baseline for the weekly jscpd scan (#1619):
`duplication-report` job. The scan fails (a red scheduled run, never a PR
gate) when the measured percentage exceeds percentage + tolerance.
percentage was measured on main at a37c3969 (2026-10-04): 1.79%, 4,758 of
265,493 production lines in 340 files, 345 clone pairs. Same scope as the
per-PR duplication gate: .jscpd.json ignores, inline #[cfg(test)] stripped.
When a refactor brings the number down, the job summary says so; lower
percentage here in that PR to lock the improvement in. Raising it is a
deliberate decision and belongs in its own reviewed change.
